facts.fact: Algeria's national personal data protection authority (ANPDP) issued a communiqué on 25 November 2026 commending the Chlef housing office for applying for prior authorisation to transfer personal data abroad.
Algeria's ANPDP, the national personal data protection authority, was acting on 25 November 2026, issuing a communiqué on a prior-authorisation request for a transfer of personal data abroad.

DZA.note: No law is named or described.

facts.fact: APS reports that the ANPDP praised the Chlef housing office (OPGI) on 25 November 2026 for applying for prior authorisation to transfer personal data abroad for its Facebook page, so a transfer needs the authority's authorisation.

DZA.note: Whether any transfer goes without permission is not stated.
